name: Farosh, Lightning Dragon
info: Location:  Flies clockwise between  East Gerudo Chasm  and  Hills of Baumer Chasm  (and completes the circle in The Depths)

name: Light Dragon
info: Location:  Circles the entire map high in the sky (passes all the Geoglyphs)

name: Dinraal, Fire Dragon
info: Location:  Flies from east to west along the coast north coast between  East Akkala Plains Chasm  and  Drenan Highlands Chasm  (and repeats the cycle in the Depths)

name: Naydra, Frost Dragon
info: Location:  Flies in a clockwise circle between  Naydra Snowfield Chasm  and  East Hill Chasm  - and completes the cycle in The Depths
